title: Desktop folder settings->wallpaper type: picture of the day, today's picture may not be fully downloaded.
line: If the connection drops while today's picture is downloading, Picture of the Day keeps the previous picture and tries again later instead of showing a half-gray image.
explanation: The providers decoded whatever data the download returned. A JPEG cut off mid-transfer still decodes, with the missing part filled in gray, so it was saved to the cache as the day's picture and shown until the next day; a cut off PNG decodes to nothing but was still treated as a success. The providers now decode through a shared PotdProvider::imageFromData() that rejects a JPEG whose last scan isn't followed by the end-of-image marker, and PotdClient treats a null downloaded image as a failed download, so the previous picture stays and the existing 10-minute retry kicks in.

commits.message:
wallpapers/potd: don't cache a picture that was only partly downloaded

A cut off JPEG still decodes with its missing part in gray, so it was
cached as the day's picture. Now an incomplete or undecodable download
counts as failed: the previous picture stays and it is retried later.

BUG: 518488

media.caption: Master: the Bing picture download is cut off halfway; the half-gray image is cached and shown as the wallpaper
With the fix: the same cut-off download is rejected and yesterday's complete picture stays

review.text: Keeping the previous picture and reusing the existing retry is the right outcome, and the null-image check in PotdClient::slotFinished is a good safety net. But the JPEG end-marker check works around a transport bug instead of fixing it. KIO's HTTP worker (kio src/kioworkers/http/http.cpp) only maps QNetworkReply errors when the status code is 0. A connection dropped after the 200 headers (RemoteHostClosedError, or a body shorter than Content-Length) therefore finishes the TransferJob without an error and hands back truncated data. Every KIO HTTP user gets corrupt files that way, not just potd. The verify server's setup (whether it sent Content-Length) is not stated either.
changes: Fix KIO's HTTP worker to report a mid-body network error (e.g. RemoteHostClosedError / premature close with Content-Length) as KIO::ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN even when an HTTP status was already received, so the potd providers' existing job->error() path handles it

Keep the PotdClient null-image -> slotError check; drop the JPEG marker heuristic and the new PotdProvider::imageFromData() API, or keep it only if a truncation without Content-Length is shown to still matter
Re-verify with a test server that sends Content-Length and closes early
